description: This file defines a SupabaseClient class that provides an asynchronous wrapper around Supabase REST and Auth endpoints using the httpx library. It includes methods for user authentication (sign-up, sign-in, password update), and database operations (select, insert, update, delete) with detailed request handling and logging. It also contains a factory function to instantiate this client with environment settings.

classes.name: SupabaseClient
classes.description: A wrapper class for interacting with Supabase's REST and Auth endpoints asynchronously, supporting user management and database operations.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] auth_sign_up(self, email: str, password: str, email_redirect_to: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Registers a new user with email and password, optionally redirect URL.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] auth_sign_in(self, email: str, password: str)
methods.description: Authenticates a user by email and password, returning tokens or empty dict on failure.

methods.name: bool auth_update_user_password(self, email: str, new_password: str)
methods.description: Updates a user's password using admin privileges, identified by email.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] select( self, table: str, select: str = "*", **filters )
methods.description: Performs a SELECT query on the specified table with filters.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] insert(self, table: str, rows: List[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Inserts new rows into the specified table.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] update(self, table: str, match_filters: Dict[str, Any], updates: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Updates records in a table matching filters with given changes.

methods.name: bool delete(self, table: str, match_filters: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Deletes records from a table based on filters.

methods.name: __init__(self, url: str, anon_key: str, service_role_key: str)
